lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: karamaa upar nibaRai je lochai sabh koi ||3||
lines.translation: According to the karma of past actions, one's destiny unfolds, even though everyone wants to be so lucky. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karanaa jin keeaa soee saar karei ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He alone takes care of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaapee khasam kaa kisai vadaaee dei ||4||1||18||
lines.translation: The Hukam of our Lord and Master's Command cannot be known; He Himself blesses us with greatness. ||4||1||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਬਸਾ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: haranee hovaa ban basaa ka(n)d mool chun khaau ||
lines.translation: What if I were to become a deer, and live in the forest, picking and eating fruits and roots

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee meraa sahu milai vaar vaar hau jaau jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: - by Guru's Grace, I am a sacrifice to my Master. Again and again, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਨਜਾਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai banajaaran raam kee ||
lines.translation: I am the shop-keeper of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa naam vakhar vaapaar jee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your Name is my merchandise and trade. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਹੋਵਾ ਅੰਬਿ ਬਸਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kokil hovaa a(n)b basaa sahaj sabad beechaar ||
lines.translation: If I were to become a cuckoo, living in a mango tree, I would still contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj subhaai meraa sahu milai darasan roop apaar ||2||
lines.translation: I would still meet my Lord and Master, with intuitive ease; the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of His Form, is incomparably beautiful. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਸਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: machhulee hovaa jal basaa jee ja(n)t sabh saar ||
lines.translation: If I were to become a fish, living in the water, I would still remember the Lord, who watches over all beings and creatures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਮਿਲਉਗੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: uravaar paar meraa sahu vasai hau milaugee baah pasaar ||3||
lines.translation: My Husband Lord dwells on this shore, and on the shore beyond; I would still meet Him, and hug Him close in my embrace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਗਨਿ ਹੋਵਾ ਧਰ ਵਸਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naagan hovaa dhar vasaa sabad vasai bhau jaai ||
lines.translation: If I were to become a snake, living in the ground, the Shabad would still dwell in my mind, and my fears would be dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa sohaaganee jin jotee jot samaai ||4||2||19||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are forever the happy soul-brides, whose light merges into His Light. ||4||2||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee deepakee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee Deepkee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai ghar keerat aakheeai karate kaa hoi beechaaro ||
lines.translation: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarahu sirajanahaaro ||1||
lines.translation: - in that house, sing the Songs of Praise, and meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum gaavahu mere nirabhau kaa sohilaa ||
lines.translation: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jaau jit sohilai sadaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit nit jeeaRe samaaleean dekhaigaa devanahaar ||
lines.translation: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tere daanai keemat naa pavai tis daate kavan sumaar ||2||
lines.translation: Your gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)bat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel ||
lines.translation: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come - let's gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਆਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dehu sajan aaseesaReeaa jiu hovai saahib siu mel ||3||
lines.translation: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadaRe nit pava(n)n ||
lines.translation: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: sadanahaaraa simareeai naanak se dih aava(n)n ||4||1||20||
lines.translation: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee guaareree || mahalaa 3 chaupade ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree: Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur miliai har melaa hoee ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Guru, we meet the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel milaavai soee ||
lines.translation: He Himself unites us in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh sabh bidh aape jaanai ||
lines.translation: My God knows all His Own Ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hukame mele sabad pachhaanai ||1||
lines.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He unites those who recognize the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai bhai bhram bhau jaai ||
lines.translation: By the Fear of the True Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai raachai sach ra(n)g samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Imbued with His Fear, we are absorbed in the Love of the True One. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur miliai har man vasai subhaai ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Guru, the Lord naturally dwells within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh bhaaraa keemat nahee paai ||
lines.translation: My God is Great and Almighty; His value cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad saalaahai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, I praise Him; He has no end or limitations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh bakhase bakhasanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: My God is the Forgiver. I pray that He may forgive me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur miliai sabh mat budh hoi ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Guru, all wisdom and understanding are obtained.
